data.name: Animate Tree
data.description: You can animate a tree within 180 feet as a standard action. This functions as a treant's animate trees ability, with the following exceptions. Each day, you can animate %1 trees, and you can control up to %2 trees at a time. A tree remains animated for %3 minutes, or until dismissed by you or destroyed.|3+CHA|(PsychicLVL-11)/2|10*PsychicLVL
